/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
const cases = [
  ['/products/lamp?currency=EUR', 'Brass lamp', 'EUR 110.40', 'Stone vase'],
  ['/products/lamp?currency=USD', 'Brass lamp', 'USD 120.00', 'Stone vase'],
  ['/products/vase?currency=EUR', 'Stone vase', 'EUR 73.60', 'Brass lamp'],
  ['/products/vase', 'Stone vase', 'USD 80.00', 'Brass lamp'],
]
for (const [path, name, price, related] of cases) {
  const response = await fetch("'`http://localhost:3000${path}`)
  const chunks = []
  for await (const chunk of response.body) chunks.push(new TextDecoder().decode(chunk))
  const index = (marker) => chunks.findIndex((chunk) => chunk.includes(marker))
  assert.equal(response.status, 200)
  assert.equal(index('"'Signal Shop collection'), 0)
  assert.equal(index('Loading product details'), 0)
  assert.ok(index(name) > 0)
  assert.ok(index(price) > 0)
  assert.ok(index('Loading related products') >= 0)
  assert.ok(index(related) > index(price))
  console.log("'`${path}: product chunk ${index(price)}, related chunk ${index(related)}`)
}
NODE'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- .gitignore next.config.ts app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts"
